نحتفي (form VIII)
# نَحْتَفِي (naḥtafī) /naħ.ta.fiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
# نَحْتَفِيَ (naḥtafiya) /naħ.ta.fi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَفَى (iḥtafā)
